$comment: English texts of data/professions.json (src/engine/overlay.js): Herbalism, Alchemy and Crafting with their places, herbs, potions, reports and messages, the System Avatar, and how potions are drunk on explorations. Mining and Jewelcrafting (stage 4): the System Mine and the System Gem Workshop, stones and ores (Jewelcrafting speaks of stones, as the glossary's Stone, not of gems); a mineral's `genitive` is its plain name too. Herbs and potions are names, in Title Case wherever they appear (the bag, recipes, quests, reports). A herb's or a profession's `genitive` is its plain name: the quests say "Gather 12 pieces of Comfrey" and a report "Herbalism level reached: 5". A potion's `counted` is its name after a number, [one, other, other] for the Polish [one, few, many] (src/engine/text.js, countedForm): "Brew 3 Healing Potions"; its first form also stands alone in the fight lines ("Mira drinks Healing Potion: +40 HP"). potionUse.fightForms make {fights}: "for 2 fights". The Polish kinds of potion keep their own words: mikstura Potion, wywar Brew, napar Draught, eliksir Elixir, olejek Oil, balsam Balm. The places: Systemowy Zagajnik System Grove, Systemowa Pracownia System Laboratory, Systemowy Warsztat System Workshop.
intro: While working, the character does not set out on explorations, and their wounds heal. Each profession level strengthens two stats. You can develop every profession, but you work in only one at a time.

avatar.name: System Avatar
avatar.description: A reflection of the character that the System will weave in their likeness. It works at the professions alongside them, even while the character is on an exploration or working too. It knows their herbs, recipes and patterns and works just as efficiently. From its work the character gets a quarter of the experience and profession progress the same work would give them.

bought: The System has woven the Avatar. It waits for work in the Professions.
busy: The System Avatar is already working. Wait until its work is done.
claimFirst: The System Avatar has finished its work. Claim its report first.

herbalism.name: Herbalism
herbalism.description: Gathering herbs in the System Grove, with no fights and no risk.

mining.name: Mining
mining.description: Digging up gemstones, ores and gold in the System Mine.

jewelcrafting.name: Jewelcrafting
jewelcrafting.description: Making jewellery and setting stones in the System Gem Workshop.

place.name: System Grove
place.description: More grows here than meets the eye. The System reveals herbs only when it judges that you can recognise them.

place.name: System Laboratory
place.description: The cauldron heats here without fire, and the shelves wait for vials. The System reveals recipes only when it judges that you can brew them.

report: In the Laboratory the cauldron bubbles, and vials pile up on the shelf.
The herbs give the brew the very best they have.
The System's blue lines measure every drop of the potion.
lost: The bag was full. No room for: {potions}.
stopped: Brewing stopped. The herbs for the rest went back to the bag.
revealed: The System reveals a new recipe: {potion}
hidden: Hidden by the System until Alchemy level {level}.
herbalistHidden: Jagna's rare recipe: needs standing {standing} with Jagna or with the Brotherhood of Herbalists, and Alchemy level {level}.
busy: The character is brewing potions. Wait until the brewing ends.
claimFirst: The brewing is over. Claim the report first.
pushBody: Potions brewed: {place}. Your report is ready to collect.

place.name: System Workshop
place.description: Neatly sorted tools seem to be waiting to be used. But that takes skilled hands. Some patterns will open to you only when the System judges that you can manage them.

scroll.name: Ward Scroll
scroll.description: A System scroll for the Anvil. When upgrading from +7 up, it guards the item against breaking, but not against losing its upgrade: the Steady Scroll guards against that.

steadyScroll.name: Steady Scroll
steadyScroll.description: A System scroll for the Anvil. When an upgrade attempt fails, the item does not lose its upgrade level. It does not guard against breaking: the Ward Scroll does that.

exchange.title: Part exchange
exchange.text: On the spot, no waiting: for 10 parts of one rarity, the System gives 1 part of the next rarity.

report: In the Workshop the hammer rings, and the pattern slowly takes shape.
The parts fit together as if they had been waiting for the right hands.
The System's blue lines guide every seam and every blow.
stored: The finished items wait in the Storeroom, outside your bag.
failed: Failed: {items}. The parts were lost, and the camp's resources came back.
stopped: Crafting stopped. The parts and resources for the rest came back.
rarity: The System now lets you craft items of rarity: {rarity}
hidden: Hidden by the System until Crafting level {level}.
busy: The character is crafting items. Wait until the crafting ends.
claimFirst: The crafting is over. Claim the report first.
pushBody: Items crafted: {place}. Your report is ready to collect.
lucky: A stroke of luck! An item of higher rarity: {item} ({rarity}).

place.name: System Mine
place.description: Paths lead deep beneath the wilds, and veins of ore glitter in the walls. The System reveals stones only when it judges that you can dig them out.

about: You dig up everything the System has already revealed to you: gemstones, one for each rarity, and ores. Each Mining level gives {yield}% more output.
Along the way your pickaxe strikes gold veins. On average they give {share}% of the gold an hour of exploration brings at your character level.
Stones and ores take no room in the bag. The scrap dealer will buy them, and in Jewelcrafting you can make jewellery from them.

report: In the Mine the pickaxes thud, and the basket fills with ore.
Veins of ore run deep, as if someone had drawn them there.
The System's blue lines guide every swing of the pickaxe.
revealed: The System reveals a new stone: {mineral}
revealedOre: The System reveals a new ore: {mineral}
hidden: Hidden by the System until Mining level {level}.
busy: The character is digging in the Mine. Wait until the digging ends.
claimFirst: The digging is over. Claim the report first.
pushBody: Digging finished: {place}. Your report is ready to collect.

place.name: System Gem Workshop
place.description: The grinding wheels turn here on their own, and settings wait on the table. Some stones will open to you only when the System judges that you can manage them.

craft: A ring, amulet or talisman has the rarity of the stone you make it from. The setting also needs ore: silver, gold or star ore.
Making can fail: then the stone is lost, and the ore comes back. Finished jewellery has your character level, and its properties bear the names of creatures you know.
set: Each item can hold one stone. It raises all the item's values by the percentage the stone gives: the rarer the stone, the more.
A new stone destroys the previous one. You can set a stone from the same Jewelcrafting level at which Mining finds it.

report: The grinding wheel sings, and the stone takes on its shine.
The setting closes round the stone as if it had been waiting for just this one.
The System's blue lines guide every cut and every setting.
stored: The finished jewellery waits in the Storeroom, outside your bag.
failed: Failed: {items}. The stones were lost, and the ore came back.
stopped: Making stopped. The stones and ore for the rest came back.
set: {gem} is now set in the item: {item}.
replaced: The previous stone, {gem}, crumbled during the setting.
missing: This item is gone. The stone went back to the bag: {gem}.
gem: The System now lets you cut and set the stone: {gem}
hidden: Hidden by the System until Jewelcrafting level {level}.
busy: The character is working in the Gem Workshop. Wait until the work ends.
claimFirst: The work in the Gem Workshop is over. Claim the report first.
pushBody: Work finished: {place}. Your report is ready to collect.
gemHelp: A stone set in the Gem Workshop raises every value of this item by {percent}%: damage, armour and every property on the list, each by at least 1. The values on this card already include it.

quartz.name: Quartz
quartz.description: A milky-white crystal, the most common in the Mine's walls.

agate.name: Agate
agate.description: A stone in coloured bands, like the rings of an old tree.

amethyst.name: Amethyst
amethyst.description: A violet crystal, cool even in a warm hand.

emerald.name: Emerald
emerald.description: Green as young leaves, rare and brittle.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.description: Deep blue and hard as steel.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.description: Red as embers that never go out.

diamond.name: Diamond
diamond.description: The hardest stone in the Mine. It shines even in total darkness.

silver-ore.name: Silver Ore
silver-ore.description: Silver ore for the settings of common, rare and unique jewellery.

gold-ore.name: Gold Ore
gold-ore.description: Gold ore for the settings of epic and legendary jewellery.

star-ore.name: Star Ore
star-ore.description: Ore from shards of stars, for the settings of mythic and divine jewellery.

buffLabels.poison: Poisoned Weapon: {bonus}% chance of Poison per blow

drunkSpeed: The character drinks {potion}. Speed in fights rises by {bonus}% for {fights}.
speedFights: Swiftness was active in {fights} of {all} fights.
drinkCure: {actor} drinks {potion}: {effect} is gone and will not return until the end of the fight.
drinkRevive: {actor} falls, but drinks {potion} and gets up with {amount} HP.
drunkArmor: The character drinks {potion}. Armour rises by {bonus}% for {fights}.
drunkDamage: The character drinks {potion}. Damage rises by {bonus}% for {fights}.
drunkFocus: The character drinks {potion}. Intellect and Wisdom rise by {bonus}% for {fights}.
drunkPoison: The character coats their weapon with {potion}. For {fights}, every blow has a {bonus}% chance of Poison.
drunkWard: The character drinks {potion}. Damage from magic falls by {bonus}% for {fights}.
drunkTrip: The party fights this exploration as it set out, so this bonus will work from the next exploration.
armorFights: Tough Skin was active in {fights} of {all} fights.
damageFights: Strength was active in {fights} of {all} fights.
focusFights: Focus was active in {fights} of {all} fights.
poisonFights: Aconite Oil was active in {fights} of {all} fights.
wardFights: Magic Ward was active in {fights} of {all} fights.
curseFights: The Curse weakened the blows in {fights} of {all} fights.
woundsFights: Wounds weakened the blows in {fights} of {all} fights.

comfrey.name: Comfrey
comfrey.description: Rough leaves and a fleshy root. For ages it has knit wounds and bones.

mugwort.name: Mugwort
mugwort.description: A silvery herb with a bitter scent. It clears the mind and wakes dormant power.

nettle.name: Nettle
nettle.description: It stings whoever picks it, but its juice quickens every move.

plantain.name: Ribwort
plantain.description: Narrow leaves beside every path. Laid on a wound, it stanches the blood.

st-johns-wort.name: St John's Wort
st-johns-wort.description: Yellow flowers, and leaves that show tiny holes against the light. It clears the mind.

calamus.name: Calamus
calamus.description: A fragrant root from the waterside. It draws poison from the blood.

arnica.name: Arnica
arnica.description: Orange flowers from mountain meadows. It heals bruises.

wormwood.name: Wormwood
wormwood.description: The bitterest herb in the wilds. It warms and gives strength.

valerian.name: Valerian
valerian.description: A strong-smelling root that calms the thoughts.

cranberry.name: Cranberry
cranberry.description: Red berries from the mossy bogs, sour and cool.

mistletoe.name: Mistletoe
mistletoe.description: It grows high in the trees and wards off witchcraft.

fern-blossom.name: Fern Flower
fern-blossom.description: It blooms once a year, on the shortest night. Few have ever seen it.

lesser-healing.name: Lesser Healing Potion
lesser-healing.description: A ruby brew of Comfrey. It knits wounds: heals 20% of max HP.

lesser-mana.name: Lesser Mana Potion
lesser-mana.description: A sapphire brew of Mugwort. It wakes dormant power: restores 30% of max mana.

lesser-speed.name: Lesser Swiftness Potion
lesser-speed.description: A yellow-green brew of Nettle. Drunk from the bag, it raises the character's speed in fights by 15% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

healing.name: Healing Potion
healing.description: A ruby brew of Comfrey and Ribwort. It knits wounds: heals 35% of max HP.

mana.name: Mana Potion
mana.description: A sapphire brew of Mugwort and St John's Wort. It wakes dormant power: restores 45% of max mana.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A bitter brew of Calamus. Works on its own in a fight: it removes Poison and guards against it until the end of the fight.

speed.name: Swiftness Potion
speed.description: A green brew of Nettle and Arnica. Drunk from the bag, it raises the character's speed in fights by 25% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

stoneskin-brew.name: Stoneskin Brew
stoneskin-brew.description: A grey brew of Arnica. Drunk from the bag, it strengthens the character's armour by 15% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

strength-brew.name: Strength Brew
strength-brew.description: An orange brew of Wormwood. Drunk from the bag, it raises the character's damage by 10% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

focus-draught.name: Focus Potion
focus-draught.description: A violet brew of Valerian. Drunk from the bag, it raises the character's Intellect and Wisdom by 10% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

owl-draught.name: Owl Draught
owl-draught.description: A dark violet draught of Valerian and St John's Wort, made to Jagna's recipe. Drunk from the bag, it raises the character's Intellect and Wisdom by 20% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

bearskin-brew.name: Bearskin Brew
bearskin-brew.description: A brown brew of Arnica and Cranberry, made to Jagna's recipe. Drunk from the bag, it strengthens the character's armour by 30% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

greater-healing.name: Greater Healing Potion
greater-healing.description: A thick ruby brew of Comfrey and Cranberry. It knits even deep wounds: heals 50% of max HP.

greater-mana.name: Greater Mana Potion
greater-mana.description: A dark sapphire brew of Mugwort and Cranberry. It restores 60% of max mana.

wolf-strength-brew.name: Wolf Strength Brew
wolf-strength-brew.description: A dark red brew of Wormwood and Cranberry, made to Jagna's recipe. Drunk from the bag, it raises the character's damage by 20% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

greater-speed.name: Greater Swiftness Potion
greater-speed.description: A bright green brew of Nettle and Cranberry. Drunk from the bag, it raises the character's speed in fights by 35% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

aconite-oil.name: Aconite Oil
aconite-oil.description: A dark oil of Aconite for the blade. Applied from the bag, for 2 fights it gives each of the character's blows a 50% chance of Poison. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

burn-brew.name: Burn Remedy
burn-brew.description: A cool brew of Cranberry and Ribwort, made to Jagna's recipe. Works on its own in a fight: it removes Burn and guards against it until the end of the fight.

mistletoe-elixir.name: Mistletoe Elixir
mistletoe-elixir.description: A white and green elixir of Mistletoe. Drunk from the bag, it reduces the damage from magic by 20% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

evil-eye-brew.name: Draught against Hexes
evil-eye-brew.description: A silvery draught of Mistletoe and St John's Wort, made to Jagna's recipe. Drunk from the bag, it reduces the damage from magic by 35% for 2 fights. Each further one adds 2 more fights.

jagna-balm.name: Jagna's Balm
jagna-balm.description: A thick, golden balm of Comfrey, Cranberry and Fern Flower, made to Jagna's recipe. It knits even the deepest wounds: heals 70% of max HP.

fern-brew.name: Fern Flower Draught
fern-brew.description: A golden draught of Fern Flower. Works on its own: once per exploration it saves the character from defeat, bringing them back up with 30% HP.

report: The Grove rustles softly, and the basket fills with herbs.
The herbs grow here in even rows, as if someone had planted them.
The System's blue light flickers above the clumps of herbs.
lost: The bag was full. No room for: {herbs}.
revealed: The System reveals a new herb: {herb}
hidden: Hidden by the System until Herbalism level {level}.
busy: The character is gathering herbs. Wait until the gathering ends.
claimFirst: The gathering is over. Claim the report first.
pushBody: Herb gathering complete: {place}. Your report is ready to collect.
